title: Amajwi y'Imana Iruhande y'Umuhanuzi
intro: Mu gihugu ca kure, intumwa y’icubahiro yarashikiwe n’ukwangwa bimwe bikomeye n’abategetsi bo muri ico gihe. Yamara rero, uruziga rutoyi rw’imitima yihebeye Imana rwahagaze iruhande y’uwo musavyi wa Allah, rushashaye kwishura umuhamagaro w’Imana. Ukwemera kwabo kudatezuka kwotumye ihanga rikomeye rigabanywamwo ibice, amaherezo rigatsinda inguvu z’ukutemera.
clues: Twari umugwi mutoyi wihebeye Imana, twunze ubumwe mu kwizera no mu ntumbero.
Twarahagaze iruhande y’intumwa y’icubahiro yanse n’abategetsi b’inkomezi bo mu gihugu cabo.
Igihe uwo ntumwa yabaza ati: «Ni bande banshigikiye mu nzira ya Allah?» twarishuye ata gukekeranya.
Twasavye iyo ntumwa kurondera umusi mukuru uva mw’ijuru kugira ngo uzane uguhumurizwa mu mitima yacu.
Mu bantu bo muri ico gihe, bamwe barizeye biciye ku butumwa bwacu abandi baranka n’ubutagondwa, ariko Allah yarakomeje abemera.
Turi aba Hawwariyyun — abigishwa ba Isa bitanga, bagizwe abatsinzi biciye ku nkunga ya Allah.

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
